phase_and_counter_boundaries.CH_DH: CH common PAPER_BASE PIB256 and DH active OO PIB128 are separate typed domains; generic DH front-end8 is inactive. Cross-design proxies do not establish equal structure or area.
phase_and_counter_boundaries.additive: Only parser-certified cumulative additive metrics are differenced. First actual constructor-zero is explicit; later differences require both explicit endpoints and nondecrease. Missing endpoints yield null, never zero.
phase_and_counter_boundaries.capture_source: Candidate source and exact trace identity remain distinct. myocyte accepted integration step/adaptive attempt IDs and 3DCONV scalar_i remain null. SRAD second-pass reduce is separate.
phase_and_counter_boundaries.gauge_peak: Preserve print snapshots separately; never difference or sum. Running peak is not phase-local peak.
phase_and_counter_boundaries.identity: Actual source profile/cohort/UUID/SHA governs; old comparison_profile aliases do not redefine original P0. No per-program best-profile selection.
phase_and_counter_boundaries.mean_latency: Raw printed mean snapshots retain diagnostic sampling window; never difference, add, or promote to exact whole-application means. Missing means are not zero.
phase_and_counter_boundaries.mechanism: Facts, source inference, correlation and unconfirmed cause remain distinct. Read-active print interval does not establish cold/compulsory/cache-miss origin.
phase_and_counter_boundaries.phase_sums: A missing additive interval makes the formal phase total null with missing interval count; no partial total is represented as complete.
